cards.claim: Henry Cavendish, 2nd Duke of Newcastle was born on 24 June 1630.
cards.quote: Henry Cavendish, 2nd Duke of Newcastle Henry Cavendish, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-upon-Tyne, KG, PC (24 June 1630 – 26 July 1691), styled Viscount Mansfield until 1676, was an English politician who sat in the House of Commons from 1660 to 1676, and then inherited the dukedom.

cards.entity: Henry Fiennes Pelham-Clinton, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-under-Lyne
cards.claim: Henry Fiennes Pelham-Clinton, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-under-Lyne was born on 16 April 1720.
cards.quote: Henry Pelham-Clinton, 2nd Duke of Newcastle Henry Fiennes Pelham-Clinton, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-under-Lyne, KG, PC (16 April 1720 – 22 February 1794) was born in London, the second son of the 7th Earl of Lincoln.
